changes: Fix #329: muting Scene A or B (FUNC + SCENE A/B) now stops that scene's MIDI locks, as stock scene mute does for audio tracks. With one scene muted the crossfader morphs between the base value and the other scene. Muting the last scene sends the CC back to its base or trig-lock value, and the crossfader then leaves it unchanged.
Editing scene locks while holding a muted scene's key still works, as in stock.

This is a small Modwerk patch on top of the author's unchanged MIDISC2.0 release recipe. It also corrects an unassigned-scene fallback in the crossfader mix that produced out-of-range values. The reporter tested this build on an Octatrack MKII, including Part, project and reboot persistence. MIDI Scenes must still be selected alone.
Known limitation, unchanged from 0.2.4: editing a scene lock while holding its key does not send the CC until the crossfader moves.
Replace the earlier relocatable package with the author’s exact standalone MIDISC2.0 release recipe and enable its verified browser build.
MIDI Scenes must be selected alone; combinations with other modules are refused. Broad hardware and timing qualification is still pending.
Documentation-only: add real emulator screenshots of the selection and control pages, access instructions and capture provenance. The firmware implementation is unchanged.
Documentation/catalog update to the author’s MIDISC2.0 feature set. Firmware builds are held pending verification; the retained relocatable assembly still implements the earlier 8.2-derived version.
Document standalone pre-trig scenes, pattern/Part boundary timing, held trig locks, CC-before-notes and the author’s fixes without claiming they are already in the Modwerk build.
Enable browser firmware builds from verified source packages, with native/browser composition and rejection checks recorded.
First Modwerk catalog release of the 1.40MIDISC8.2-derived MIDI scene-lock patch, with scene A/B crossfader morphing and Part save/reload support.
